text: At its April 2018 meeting, Toronto and East York Community Council (TE31.62) extended the existing permit and conditions for the development at 19 Duncan Street, on Duncan Street south of Adelaide Street West, for approximately one month. Community members had raised some concerns about the safety of this area with the construction staging area, so the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District, was directed to review these concerns in consultation with the ward councillor. Staff are continuing to work with the ward councillor and the developer to review options, and anticipate finalizing the issue in time for the June 2018 meeting of Community Council. As a result, I am requesting an additional extension of the existing permit and conditions for one more month.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the continuation of the closure of the east sidewalk on Duncan Street, between Adelaide Street West and a point 31 metres south, from May 31, 2018 to June 30, 2018. 2. Approved the continuation of the closure of a 2.6 metre wide portion of the northbound curb lane on Duncan Street, between Adelaide Street West and a point 31 metres south, from May 31, 2018 to June 30, 2018. 3. Approved the continuation of the provision of a 1.5 metre wide covered and protected walkway within the closed portion of the northbound lane on Duncan Street, between Adelaide Street West and a point 31 metres south, from May 31, 2018 to June 30, 2018. 4. Approved the continuation of one-way southbound traffic operation on Duncan Street, between Adelaide Street West and Pearl Street, from May 31, 2018 to June 30, 2018. 5.
